title: 1.1 Traversals Protocol
concept: Inorder traversal of a general binary tree
objective: Click the 7 tree nodes in exact Inorder sequence (Left -> Root -> Right)!
controls: Click nodes in Inorder sequence  |  Hover for node stats
start_status: Click nodes in Inorder sequence: start with the leftmost node.
hints: Inorder = Left, Root, Right. Begin with the leftmost node: keep following left children until there are none.
After a node, visit the leftmost node of its right subtree; with no right child, climb to the parent.
